description:
This is a screenshot of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CLC+ Data Catalogue user interface, showing the "Data Catalogue" section with filtering capabilities and a list of land cover/land use datasets. The top navigation bar includes "Data Catalogue", "EAGLE Ontology", "About EAGLE", "Organisations", and "Users".

The main area is divided into two panels. The left panel, labeled "Filter", allows users to refine the data displayed. Filter criteria include "Created At", "Country", "Region" (with a prompt to "Select at least one country"), "Reference Year", "Resolution" (with checkboxes for "10 meters" and "100 meters"), "Time Range", "Status", and "INSPIRE Themes". Two toggle switches, "Show only EAGLE approved ingestions" and "Show ARCHIVED data", are also present.

The right panel displays a table of datasets with the following columns: "Created At", "Created By", "Country", "Region", "Reference Year", "Time Range", "Organisation/s", "Status", "INSPIRE Themes", and "Resolution".
Example data entries include:
*   Entries created by "CLC+ Core User Ad..." for "Spain/España" (Jaén, Galicia regions) with "Reference Year" values like 2018 and 2026, "Time Range" such as "01.09.2026 - 19.09.2026" or "01.01.2017 - 31.12.2018", "Status" as EXTRACTED, USED, or DRAFT, and "INSPIRE Themes" like "Land use, Land cover" or "Geographical grid systems", all with a "Resolution" of "100 m".
*   Entries created by "Innerbichler Florian" for "Luxembourg" with "Reference Year" values of 2024, 2021, and 2018, "Time Range" such as "01.01.2024 - 31.12.2024" or "01.03.2018 - 31.07.2018", "Status" as USED, and "INSPIRE Themes" including "Land use, Land cover" or "Addresses, Geographical grid systems", all with a "Resolution" of "10 m".

Above the table, action buttons are visible: "ADD INGESTION" and "ADD EXTRACTION". Pagination controls at the bottom right indicate "Items per page: 10" and show "1 - 10 of 92" total items. The background image appears to be an aerial view of agricultural land. The bottom left of the interface displays logos for "Copernicus", "EAGLE Land Monitoring in Europe", "European Commission", and the "European Environment Agency (EEA)". A help icon ('?') is visible in the bottom right corner.
